mapper.select: select distinct ct.id as id, ct.status as status, t.name as templateName, ct.calculation_cycle_start_date as cycleStart, ct.calculation_cycle_end_date as cycleEnd, ct.calculation_end_time as finishedAt from emission_calculation_template ct left join emission_template t on t.id = ct.template_id inner join emission_calculation_node cn on cn.calculation_template_id = ct.id where cn.node_id = #{subjectNodeId} and ct.calculation_cycle_start_date <= #{periodEnd} and ct.calculation_cycle_end_date >= #{periodStart} order by ct.calculation_end_time desc

select d.id as id, cn.calculation_template_id as calculationTemplateId, d.emission_category as emissionCategory, d.emission_subcategory as emissionSubcategory, d.energy_measurement_value as energyMeasurementValue, d.adjusted_energy_value as adjustedEnergyValue, d.carbon_emission as carbonEmission, d.measurement_unit as measurementUnit, d.collection_point_id as collectionPointId, d.collection_point_type as collectionPointType, coalesce(fm.energy_allocation, em.energy_allocation, hm.energy_allocation) as energyAllocation, coalesce(fm.name, em.name, hm.name) as facilityName from emission_collection_node_data d inner join emission_calculation_node cn on cn.id = d.calculation_node_id left join emission_fossil_fuel_meter_info fm on d.collection_point_type = 2 and fm.id = d.collection_point_id left join emission_meter_info em on d.collection_point_type = 1 and em.id = d.collection_point_id left join emission_purchased_heat_meter_info hm on d.collection_point_type = 3 and hm.id = d.collection_point_id where cn.calculation_template_id = #{calculationTemplateId} and coalesce(fm.energy_allocation, em.energy_allocation, hm.energy_allocation) = #{energyAllocation}

select ct.id as calculationTemplateId, ct.template_id as emissionTemplateId, t.name as emissionTemplateName, t.factor_template_id as factorTemplateId, ft.template_name as factorTemplateName from emission_calculation_template ct left join emission_template t on t.id = ct.template_id left join emission_factor_template ft on ft.id = t.factor_template_id where ct.id = #{calculationTemplateId}

select id as id, template_id as templateId, subcategory_code as subcategoryCode, subcategory_name as subcategoryName, factor_source as factorSource, factor_id as factorId, factor_name as factorName, factor_value as factorValue, factor_unit as factorUnit, status as status from emission_default_factor where template_id = #{templateId} and (status is null or status = 1)

select id as id, fuel_type as fuelType, unit as unit, lower_heating_value as lowerHeatingValue, carbon_content_per_unit_heat as carbonContentPerUnitHeat, fuel_oxidation_rate as fuelOxidationRate, emission_factor as emissionFactor, factor_unit as factorUnit from emission_fossil_fuel_emission_factor where id = #{id}
